; quadratic.txt - readable source for quadratic.bin (label Quadratic in main.asm)
;
; Quadratic ease table: a sine-shaped wave built from parabolas, 2048 steps
; per turn, as signed 16-bit words. For each half-turn p = 0..1023:
;   x = p / 512,  entry = +/- int(32767 * (2x - x*x)), truncated toward zero
;   positive for entries 0..1023, negative for 1024..2047
;   range -32767..32767; entry 512 is the peak, 1536 the trough
;
; It is indexed with the same angles as the sine table, so keep 2048 entries.
; Read by ActionPush (player_fsm.asm) to ease a pushed crate across
; one tile.
;
; Edit the values and rebuild: tools/convert_data_tables.py writes the .bin
; (big-endian words) on every build. ';' starts a comment.
;
; entries: 2048
;
; Values below: 8 per line; the comment gives the index of the first value.
